title: v5 can't override generateId in generateText / streamText
body:
### Description

On v5 it looks like the `experimental_generateId` has been removed, preventing the user from overriding the messageId generator, it seems there's no way to do this now.

I see there's a `generateId` in `createUIMessageStream` but it doesn't seem to have any effect, as the generated Id is overridden by the default implementation in streamText.

### AI SDK Version

- ai: 5.0.0-beta.12

linked_prs.title: fix (ui): inject generated response message id
linked_prs.body:
## Background

It was not possible to override the generated message id in the ui message stream.

## Summary

Add `generateMessageId` property to `toUIMessageStream` on stream text result.

## Related Issues

Fixes #7178

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns the inability to override the message ID generator in agent message streams, which relates to memory mechanisms and message handling within the agent system—specifically, memory content errors and memory initialization/configuration. This matches the agent issue taxonomy for memory-related agent behaviors.
